text:
maya: Quick sync — should we push Alt-Routing (route-by-cost tiers) into next sprint to address a few customer asks and a competitor parity signal?

sam: Quick thought: shipping a basic alt-routing API + fallback is ~2 dev-weeks. Full policy UI + analytics is ~1 month.

eli: infra note: autoscaling impact looks minimal, but we need a model-variant mapping table and KV for rollouts. estimate 3 infra days.

nina: CS recap: two enterprise pilots explicitly asked for 'route by cost' + SLA pinning. One said they'd pause GA sign-up without pinning.

oliver: Product angle — we can ship a minimal API now as a differentiator vs CompetitorX, then follow with Console rollout controls. preserves velocity.

maya: Proposed launch criteria: API + backend mapping + simple canary rollout + docs. Gate: e2e perf must be within 10% of current latency SLO.

sam: Also need RBAC & audit events for enterprise customers. MVP RBAC could be a toggle; full role model later.

support-bot: Customer C (AcmeCorp) created ticket #4521 — severity=low — mentions: "missing routing controls blocking pilot"

nina: Can we do a quick spike on Console? @sam can we collapse RBAC to MVP (single-flag) so we can defer full audit retention?

sam: Yes — MVP plan: flag-based RBAC + emit audit events to the event bus. Dev plan:
```
- API: POST /v1/routes/cost-tier -> v0
- Backend: mapping table + fallback rules
- Console: toggle + canary slider (no graphs in v0)
- Docs: quickstart + customer note on SLA pinning
```

eli: I'll prep infra mapping and feature-flagging. Need model-variant compatibility list from research before we finalize routing matrix.

maya: Decision: prioritize API + backend + MVP RBAC + canary in next sprint. Console UX + analytics follow-up across the next 2 sprints. I'll notify sales & CS. @nina please ping the customers with the staged plan.

nina: Pinged both customers. They prefer staged ship as long as SLA pinning is documented and transparent.

oliver: Note for Optimize: measure token-cost delta for routing by cost and add recommendation rules post-GA.

sam: I'll open PRs for API + feature-flag tomorrow and tag @eli for infra changes.

maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
